## Get reactome gene sets

```{r,reactome}

gmt_import <- function(gmtfile) {
    genesetLines <- strsplit(readLines(gmtfile), "\t")
    genesets <- lapply(genesetLines, utils::tail, -2)
    names(genesets) <- unlist(lapply(genesetLines, head, 1))
    attributes(genesets)$originfile <- gmtfile
    genesets <- genesets[lapply(genesets,length)>0]
    if( any(duplicated(names(genesets))) ) {
        warning("Duplicated gene sets names detected")
    }
    genesets
}

gs <- gmt_import("ReactomePathways_2026-10-23.gmt")

# change names to make it easier to manage
names(gs) <- sapply(1:length(gs), function(i) {
  set.seed(i*100)
  paste(sample(x=letters, size=20, replace=TRUE), collapse="",sep="")
} )

```

Make completely random gene sets.

All length = 100

```{r,random_gs}

randomGeneSets <- function(a){
  gsets <- sapply( rep(100,5000) , function(x) {
    list(as.character(sample(rownames(a),x)))
  } )
  names(gsets) <- stri_rand_strings(length(gsets), 15, pattern = "[A-Za-z]")
  return(gsets)
}

gs <- randomGeneSets(a)

```

Make random gene sets with length distribution taken from Reactome.

```{r,random_gs2}

gsr <- gmt_import("ReactomePathways_2026-10-23.gmt")

randomGeneSets2 <- function(a,gsr,nsets=5000,seed) {
  gs_lengths <- unname(unlist(lapply(gsr,length)))
  gs_lengths <- gs_lengths[which(gs_lengths >= 10)]
  set.seed(seed) ; myseeds <- sample(1:1e6,size=nsets,replace=FALSE)
  new_gs_length <- sample(gs_lengths,nsets,replace=TRUE)
  new_gs <- lapply(1:length(new_gs_length), function(i) {
    l <- new_gs_length[i]
    myseed <- myseeds[i]
    set.seed(myseed)
    as.character( sample(rownames(a),l) )
  } )
  set.seed(seed)
  names(new_gs) <- stri_rand_strings(length(new_gs), 15, pattern = "[A-Za-z]")
  return(new_gs)
}

gs2 <- randomGeneSets2(a=a, gsr=gsr, nsets=5000, seed=42)

```

## Downsample

Simulate some differential gene expression data

Effect size distributions

low=seq(0.4,0.8,0.1)

medium=seq(0.5,1.2,0.1)

high=seq(0.8,1.6,0.1)

```{r,downsample_simulation_function}

FC=c("low","medium","high")

#gsets=gs

simcounts <- function(counts, N_REPS=5, SUM_COUNT=20e6, VARIANCE=0.35, FRAC_DE_PW=0.1, effect="medium", gsets, seed=1) {

  # Use edgeR::thincounts to create pseudoreplicate datasets
  df  = NULL
  for (k in paste0("data",1:(N_REPS*2)))  {
    set.seed(seed*100)
    b <- thinCounts(a,target.size=SUM_COUNT)
    colnames(b) <- k
    df <- cbind(df,b)
  }

  ## Put some variance into the samples!
  if (VARIANCE > 0) {
    #create some random values centred around 1 with some% error
    set.seed(seed*500)
    # watch out for NA values when negative numbers are log transformed
    noise <- rnorm(nrow(a)*N_REPS*2 , 2, VARIANCE)
    noise[noise < 0] <- median(noise)
    rand <- matrix(log2(noise),ncol=N_REPS*2)
    #incorporate the noise
    df <- round(df*rand)
    #set any negative counts to zero
    df <- apply(df, 2, function(x) { ifelse(x < 0, 0, x) })
  }

  # Select gene sets with more than 10 members present in the matrix
  gsets_sub <- which(unlist( lapply(gsets,function(x) {
    length(which(rownames(a) %in% as.character(unlist(x)))) >10
  }  ) ) )
  gsets <- gsets[which(names(gsets) %in% names(gsets_sub))]

  NDIF=round(length(gsets)*FRAC_DE_PW)
  if ( NDIF%%2==1 ) { NDIF=NDIF-1 }

  if ( effect == "low" ) {
    FC_VALS <- seq(0.4,0.8,0.1)
  }
  if ( effect == "medium" ) {
    FC_VALS <- seq(0.5,1.2,0.1)
  }
  if ( effect == "high" ) {
    FC_VALS <- seq(0.8,1.6,0.1)
  }

  # generate target numbers for each pathway
  set.seed(seed*1000)
  PWFC <- sample(x=FC_VALS,size=NDIF,replace=TRUE)

  # Flip half the signs
  PWFC <- PWFC * ( ( ( 1:length(PWFC) %% 2 ) *2 ) -1 )

  # Select the DE pathways and genes
  set.seed(seed*10000)
  DEPW_LIST <- sample(gsets , NDIF)
  # dataframe of pathway name and LOGFC
  DEPW_DF <- data.frame(names(DEPW_LIST),PWFC)
  DEGENES <- unique(unlist(DEPW_LIST))

  # for each DEGENE, get the fold change of it
  # which will be a product of all the
  DELFC <- sapply(DEGENES, function(g) {
    matches <- names(which(sapply(DEPW_LIST, function(mygs) {
      length(which( mygs == g ))
    } ) == 1))
    LFC <- prod( DEPW_DF[match(matches, DEPW_DF[,1]),2] )
    return(LFC)
  } )
  names(DELFC) <- DEGENES

  # Now because the final FC of each gene is a product
  # we can find the mean of all the gene in the set
  # correlation of 0.7 between planned and final pathway level FCs
  DEPW_DF$final_LFC <- sapply(DEPW_DF$names.DEPW_LIST., function(mygs) {
    setgenes <- DEPW_LIST[[which(names(DEPW_LIST) == mygs)]]
    final_LFC <- mean(DELFC[which(names(DELFC) %in% setgenes)])
    return(final_LFC)
  } )

  ## Now simply incorporate these fold changes
  # get the steady genes with no change
  NCnames <- rownames(df[which(! rownames(df) %in% names(DELFC) ),])
  NCvec <- rep(x=1,times=length(NCnames))
  names(NCvec) <- NCnames
  # combine with the DE fold changes converted from log to linear scale
  FCvec <- c(2^DELFC,NCvec)
  FCvec <- FCvec[match(rownames(df),names(FCvec))]
  # apply fold changes to case group
  CASE <- df[,(N_REPS+1):ncol(df)]
  CASE <- round(apply(CASE,2, function(x) { x * FCvec } ))
  # no changes to ctrl group
  CTRL <- df[,1:N_REPS]
  # output the combined
  df2 <- as.data.frame(cbind(CTRL,CASE))

  ss <- data.frame(colnames(df2))
  ss$group <- c( rep(x="ctrl",times=nrow(ss)/2)  , rep(x="trt",times=nrow(ss)/2) )
  rownames(ss) <- ss[,1]
  design <- model.matrix(~ group, data = ss)
  y <- DGEList(counts = df2)
  keep <- filterByExpr(y)
  y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  y <- normLibSizes(y)
  v <- voom(y, design)
  fit <- lmFit(v, design)
  fit2 <- eBayes(fit)
  dge <- topTable(fit2, coef = "grouptrt", number = Inf, adjust.method = "fdr")
  out <- list("a"=df2,"fcdf"=DEPW_DF, "dge"=dge)
  return(out)
}

testdata <- simcounts(counts=a, N_REPS=4, SUM_COUNT=20e6,
  VARIANCE=0.4, FRAC_DE_PW=0.005, effect="medium", gsets=gs, seed=300)

str(testdata)

dge <- testdata[[3]]

n_dge <- nrow(subset(dge,adj.P.Val<0.05))

n_dge
```

## Function for running FGSEA

Run fgsea and see if the NES prioritisation works.

Run a basic test to show GT pathways are actually altered with FDR selection.

```{r,benchmark_fgsea}

# the data object is a list that contains 1 count matrix and 1 DF of PW fold changes
run_fgsea <- function(data,  gsets, seed=1) {
  de <- data[[3]]
  stats <- de$t
  names(stats) <- rownames(de)
  set.seed(seed*100)
  fres <- fgsea(pathways=gsets, stats=stats, minSize=10 )
  fres <- as.data.frame(fres)
  fres <- fres[order(fres$pval),]
  return(fres)
}

```

## Function for running ORA

```{r,benchmark_ora}

run_fora <- function(data,  gsets) {
  de <- data[[3]]
  # select genes for ORA
#  up <- unique(rownames(head(subset(de, logFC>0 & adj.P.Val<0.05),1000)))
#  dn <- unique(rownames(head(subset(de, logFC<0 & adj.P.Val<0.05),1000)))
  up <- unique(rownames(head(subset(de, logFC>0 ),1000)))
  dn <- unique(rownames(head(subset(de, logFC<0 ),1000)))
  bg <- unique(rownames(de))
  ores_up <- fora(pathways=gsets,genes=up,universe=bg,minSize=10)
  ores_dn <- fora(pathways=gsets,genes=dn,universe=bg,minSize=10)
  # flip enrichment sign for down genes
  ores_dn$foldEnrichment <- ores_dn$foldEnrichment * -1
  # combine separate tests for up and down into single output
  o_comb <- lapply(ores_up$pathway, function(x) {
    upES <- subset(ores_up,pathway==x)[,"foldEnrichment"]
    dnES <-  subset(ores_dn,pathway==x)[,"foldEnrichment"]
    if ( is.na(upES) ) { upES <- 0  }
    if ( is.na(dnES) ) { dnES <- 0  }
    if ( abs(upES) >= abs(dnES) ) {
      subset(ores_up,pathway==x)
    } else {
      subset(ores_dn,pathway==x)
    }
  } )
  ores <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind,o_comb))
  return(ores)
}

```

## Function for running GSVA

Done:
* Gaussian same as default
* ssGSEA with minmax set is bad
* zscore bad
* PLAGE is bad

Tese tests were conducted by replacing gsvaParam with others like the following:
`param <- plageParam(expr = expr, geneSets = gsets, minSize = 10, maxSize = 5000)`

We tried "Poisson" option in `gsvaParam()` but it showed worse precision with low variance testing.

I tried abs(confect)>0.2 but it had a worse precision. Here a threshold of 0.3 is used.

```{r,benchmark_gsva}

run_gsva <- function(data,  gsets) {
  mx <- data[[1]]
  ss <- data.frame(colnames(mx))
  ss$group <- c( rep(x="ctrl",times=nrow(ss)/2)  , rep(x="trt",times=nrow(ss)/2) )
  rownames(ss) <- ss[,1]
  design <- model.matrix(~ group, data = ss)
  y <- DGEList(counts = mx)
  keep <- filterByExpr(y, design= design)
  y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  y <- normLibSizes(y)
  expr <- cpm(y, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)
  param <- gsvaParam( expr = expr, geneSets = gsets, kcdf = "Gaussian", minSize = 10, maxSize = 5000)
  scores <- gsva(param)
  fit <- limma::lmFit(scores, design)
  fit <- limma::eBayes(fit, trend = TRUE, robust = TRUE)
  results <- topTable(fit, coef = "grouptrt", number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
  confects <- limma_confects(fit, coef="grouptrt", fdr=0.05)
  gres <- merge(results,confects$table,by.x=0,by.y="name")
  gres <- gres[order(abs(gres$rank)),]
  return(gres)
}

```
